title: ADR interpretations
description: Clarifications and errata for decisions in the same ADR.

slug.description: Stable identifier, unique among this ADR's interpretations.

decision.description: Slug of the decision (in the same ADR) being interpreted.

question.description: The situation or ambiguity being resolved; for errata, the error being corrected. Markdown allowed.

interpretation.description: How the decision applies; for errata, the corrected reading. Markdown allowed.

errata.description: True marks this as an erratum: a correction of a typo or editorial error that does not change the decision's meaning.
